actor.self_declared: Steward agent recording work requested by Erin Spencer in the VOICE chat. This is not a veteran self-declaration. The git commit is made through the connected GitHub login erinepshovel-code.

content: Erin Spencer requested: "create a prompt for grok build to create the app, follow skill-lib in construction, and save it to GitHub." (Answering whether to get the VOICE app going.) This entry records the addition of prompts/grok-build-voice-app.md and prompts/README.md: a proposed, self-contained Grok Build prompt to extend the existing static interface into an append-only coordination app. The app would compose entries matching the founding log schema and submit them only by opening a GitHub pull request or issue. This commit does not change README.md, index.html, or existing log lines, and it does not implement the app. The prompt is to be used in a checkout of this repository on a new branch. Any resulting app pull request must not be merged without Erin Spencer's explicit go-ahead.

provenance.interface: VOICE steward in Erin Spencer's VOICE chat, written to the repository via Git
